thresholds.tau_sat_source: the C3 lane's committed calibrated growth threshold (receipts/gdn2_growth_c3_regime.json, imported verbatim -- the same growth trigger on the same regime for cross-lane comparability)
thresholds.tau_pop_rule: the calibrated-below-registered discipline (the supervisor's ruling, mirroring the C3 lane's tau_cal rule at the POP trigger's own granularity): the trained fixed machine's own PER-HEAD smoothed-PR ceiling, measured on the post-cooldown (PRIMARY-scored) trained state
thresholds.tau_read_rule: P25 of the smoothed read-mass among per-head-saturated observations (smoothed PR >= tau_pop, the ceiling population: one argmax-boundary observation per (block, head)), on the post-cooldown trained state; pre-committed before the arms run
thresholds.hazard: the K8 idle-store hazard stated verbatim: the calibrated tau_pop is the fixed machine's own regime ceiling, NOT absolute capacity; the arm tests capacity management past the exhibited regime, not capacity management at capacity

tau_registered_unreachable.verdict: the registered 0.75*d_k = 96 thresholds are UNREACHABLE on the real C3 stream at both scanned horizons (this lane's receipts and the C3 lane's committed calibration receipts: trained fixed GDN2 PR mean ~7.5, max ~24, smoothed per-layer max ~19, per-head ceiling receipted below) -- the informative null branch of the registered 96 thresholds is delivered by these reachability receipts and is attached to the registration permanently
